tickets.subject: Sync agent crashes on macOS 14.2
tickets.resolution: Updated to version 3.1.2 which includes fix for macOS 14.2 compatibility. Customer confirmed fix on 2024-01-18.

tickets.subject: Unable to invite team members to workspace
tickets.resolution: Customer had reached seat limit on Professional plan. Walked through upgrading to Enterprise plan with additional seats. Issue resolved after plan upgrade.

tickets.subject: Selective sync not excluding specified directories
tickets.resolution: Namespace policy regex had incorrect syntax. Provided corrected pattern: ^(?!.*\.tmp$|.*/node_modules/).*$  Customer applied update and verified exclusion working.

tickets.subject: Slow sync performance after upgrading to v3.2
tickets.resolution: v3.2 introduced a new index format. Cleared local sync index and triggered full rebuild. Performance returned to normal after index rebuild. Advised to run 'cloudsync index rebuild' after future upgrades.

tickets.subject: API returning 503 errors during peak hours
tickets.resolution: Regional capacity in us-east was saturated. Engineering deployed additional sync nodes. Incident postmortem: INC-2024-042. Customer compensated with 1 month service credit.

tickets.subject: Need to bulk export all workspace data for compliance audit
tickets.resolution: Provided instructions for using CloudSync Data Export API. Customer used GET /data/export endpoint with date range filter. Export completed in 4 hours for 850 GB dataset.

tickets.subject: File encryption key rotation procedure
tickets.resolution: Guided customer through CMEK rotation process in AWS KMS. Steps: 1) Create new key version in KMS, 2) Update CloudSync key alias, 3) Trigger re-encryption job from admin console. Process took 3 hours for their 120 GB workspace.

tickets.subject: Mobile app crashing on Android 14
tickets.resolution: Identified as known issue fixed in v3.2.1. Customer's auto-update was disabled. Manually updated to v3.2.1 from Play Store. Issue resolved.

tickets.subject: Webhook integration for sync completion events
tickets.resolution: Configured webhook endpoint in admin console under Integrations > Webhooks. Customer set up endpoint https://internal.cyberdyne.example.com/hooks/sync. Test event delivered successfully.

tickets.subject: Billing discrepancy - charged for deactivated users
tickets.resolution: Audited billing records. 3 users were deactivated mid-cycle but system counted them as active due to sync events earlier in the month. Issued prorated refund of $37.50. Updated deactivation workflow to immediately stop counting.
